Click'n'Load keeps the first link of a package, downloads keep their speed to the end, and the container starts on a fresh Docker host without a chown by hand. The browser extension's settings fit into fewer cards.

## ✨ Added

- **PUID and PGID.** Started without `--user`, the container is root only long enough to give the empty folders Docker has just created for it to PUID:PGID, 1000:1000 unless you set them, and then runs as that account. A folder that already holds something keeps its owner. With `--user`, as in the Unraid template, nothing changes and PUID and PGID are not read. Settings, Health & diagnostics shows whether they were applied.

## 🎨 Design

- **The extension's settings have a Display and an In the browser card.** Display holds the theme, corners, accent colour, rainbow mode and palette under the names the web app uses. In the browser holds Click'n'Load, downloads, media and the clipboard as rows, with their explanations in info bubbles. Help and About this browser extension are separate sections.
- **The extension's theme can follow your device.** Next to light and dark, System takes the device's setting, in the popup too. The selectors sit at the end of their rows and are only as wide as they need to be.
- **Take the look from the default instance is the first row of Display.** When the extension cannot follow an instance, the switch stays off, shakes when you press it, and the reason opens in its info bubble.
- **The toolbar icon is the bare logo** without its tile. The store icon stays as it was.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Click'n'Load keeps the first link.** A site can pad the links it sends with control characters. Those stuck to the first link, so it was not taken as a link and only the later parts reached the link collector. The browser extension and the desktop app's Click'n'Load listener split on those characters, as JDownloader does. Reported in [#119](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/119).
- **Downloads keep their speed to the end.** A connection that had finished its part of a file looked only once for a slower one to help. When another connection slowed down later, it fetched the rest of its part alone, sometimes at a few KB/s for minutes, whatever the connection setting said. Finished connections keep looking while any part is still large enough to share, and a connection that has stopped receiving counts as slow. Reported in [#120](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/120).
- **The `docker run` from the README works on a fresh host.** Docker creates a missing bind-mount folder as root, so KnightLoader could not write its own data folder and restarted in a loop until you ran `chown` on the host. This happened on MOS and on any Docker host that does not create the folders itself the way Unraid does.
- **Hints that name an account name the right one.** A program that cannot be run, an action the system refuses and a folder KnightLoader may not write into name the uid and gid it actually runs as, instead of always 1000.
- **The extension's language list opens above the cards below it** instead of behind the next one, and its entries start at the list's left edge.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new and changed text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface.
